name: DSC evaluation (wmc - wmc)
summary: Computes Dice similarity, weighted Dice, Jaccard, sensitivity and TP/FP/FN between estimated and ground-truth bundles given as white matter classifications (WMC) of a tractogram, using DIPY and nibabel.
description: Converts the tractogram to .trk, extracts the selected bundles (tractID_list) from the estimated and ground-truth WMC structures and computes voxel-wise overlap scores for each pair of corresponding bundles. Use it to evaluate a bundle segmentation against a reference segmentation of the same subject. Both WMCs must refer to the same tractogram and subject; the App stops if the subject IDs differ or if the two segmentations are the same object.

inputs.description: Tractogram associated with the white matter classification (WMC) structure
inputs.requirements: Must be the tractogram both WMC structures index into, of the same subject.

inputs.description: Estimated bundles in form of white matter classification (WMC) structure
Ground truth bundles in form of white matter classification (WMC) structure

outputs.description: CSV containing the following scalars: DSC, wDSC, Jaccard, sensitivity, TP, FP, FN

parameters.description: ID list of the bundles of interest, separated by commas

citations.text: Dice, L. R. Measures of the amount of ecologic association between species. Ecology 26(3):297-302 (1945).
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: Error: estimated segmentation and ground truth segmentation are the same. DSC will be 1.
failure_modes.fix: Select a different ground truth WMC from the estimated one.

failure_modes.message: Inputs subject IDs incorrectly inserted. Check them again.
failure_modes.fix: Use inputs that all belong to the same subject.
Check that the WMC refers to the given tractogram and that tractID_list indices exist.
